title: Disaster Preparedness App
description: EverSafe Baguio is an Android disaster preparedness app built for Baguio City, PH residents, offering real-time weather monitoring, flood and landslide risk alerts, an AI-powered safety chatbot, an interactive evacuation center map, emergency contacts, and more.

title: E-commerce App
description: A MEVN E-Commerce Platform. The platform features dynamic product catalog with filtering and sorting, real-time search, seamless cart updates, secure checkout, and a comprehensive admin dashboard with real-time analytics and user management capabilities.

title: Course Booking App
description: A MERN-stack course enrollment system featuring user registration, authentication, and profile management. Authenticated users can create, update, archive, and activate courses. The platform also allows users to browse available courses and enroll seamlessly.

title: Blog Posting App
description: AliDevHub is a MEVN full-stack blogging platform that enables users to register, publish blog posts, and engage through comments. The platform includes role-based authentication, and an admin dashboard that allows administrators to manage users, posts, and comments.

title: Educational Resources Hub
description: This platform serves as a centralized educational resource hub designed to support students of the University of the Cordilleras. It provides access to curated learning materials, course-related content, and practical tools that enhance academic performance and technical skills.

title: Items Collection Shop
description: This project showcases a visually engaging anime merchandise collection shop. While it is a front-end implementation, it features interactive product listings and dynamic layouts. The interface highlights various anime-related items and allowing users to view a shop-like system.

title: E-commerce API Documentation
description: Dynamic E-Commerce Workflow Management. The system features dynamic order processing routes, real-time inventory updates, secure user authentication, automated order reporting, and comprehensive product management, with a documented API accessible via Postman.

title: Course Booking API Documentation
description: RESTful API for managing course enrollments, featuring user registration, authentication, and retrieval of user details. Supports course creation, updates, archiving, activation, and student enrollment. Publicly documented using Postman.

title: Blog Post API Documentation
description: RESTful API for Dynamic Blog Content Management. The system provides secure user authentication, dynamic routes for creating, updating, and deleting blog posts, comment management, and role-based access for administrators to oversee platform content.
